# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the manufacturer’s advertised specifications.
3. Provide a description of the product and its intended use.
4. Document the test methodology.
5. List the performance criteria.
6. Record the actual test results.
7. Compare the test results with the advertised specifications.
8. Identify discrepancies or failures.
9. Analyze the nature and significance of the discrepancies.
10. Provide quantifiable measurements where applicable.
11. Use non-technical language as much as possible for clarity.
12. Specify whether the product failed to meet just one or multiple advertised specifications.
13. Highlight the impact of the failed specifications on the product’s overall performance.
14. Ensure all records, test results, and comparisons are stored safely for audit purposes.
15. Attach images, videos, or any visual aids to further clarify the report.
16. Review your document for accuracy and consistency.
17. Include recommendations if the product can be made to meet the advertised specifications.
